integrity: The verifier independently reconstructs the complex from all 94 tetrahedra, proves H1 is torsion-free of rank two by unimodular integer reduction, certifies an integral coordinate basis using two explicit cocycles, and exhausts all three-vertex cliques. No finite-field inference is used for the integral statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the published sixteen-vertex B2 triangulation and to simple cycles measured by edge length. The displayed homology coordinates depend on the certified basis, while the multiplicities up to sign are intrinsic to the labelled complex.
title: Four primitive triangular homology classes in the sixteen-vertex flat space \(\mathcal B_2\)
